🎥🎬: National Lampoon’s Loaded Weapon 1 (1993)

When veteran detective Wes Luger is assigned to investigate the murder of a fellow police officer, he is partnered with Jack Colt, a reckless and unpredictable cop who plays by his own rules. Together, the unlikely duo uncovers a dangerous conspiracy involving a secret formula hidden inside a Girl Scout cookie recipe and a powerful criminal organization determined to get its hands on it.

As they follow the clues, the detectives find themselves caught in a ridiculous series of shootouts, car chases, betrayals, and absurd situations. With Colt’s chaotic personality clashing with Luger’s more traditional approach, their investigation becomes just as dangerous as it is hilarious.

A wild parody of action and police thrillers, Loaded Weapon 1 turns every tough-guy cliché into comedy, delivering outrageous gags and nonstop spoofs of some of Hollywood’s biggest action movies.
